page.title: Tasks
page.description: What the agents have to do and what you have to do.
page.empty: No tasks yet. <link>Create the first one</link> and assign it to yourself or an agent.

board.recentDoneOnly: Only the last 14 days. Show all

new.title: New task
new.description: Create a task for yourself or for an agent.
new.dependsOnSelected: {count, plural, one {# task selected} other {# tasks selected}}
new.runNotStarted: Task created, but the run did not start: {error}
new.startsAfterDependencies: it starts on its own once these tasks are done: {titles}

detail.deleteDescription: Its subtasks, comments, history and attachments are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
detail.runNeedsAgent: Assign the task to an agent to run it.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.uploaded: {count, plural, one {File uploaded} other {# files uploaded}}
attachments.empty: No files. Max {max} MB per file.

detail.circuitOpen: Stopped after {failures, plural, one {# failed run} other {# failed runs}}
detail.circuitOpenHint: Delegations and finished dependencies no longer start it, since it would fail the same way. Fix the cause, then start it again.

errors.notAssigned: The task is not assigned to an agent
errors.selfDependency: A task cannot depend on itself
errors.dependencyNotFound: A task it depends on does not exist
errors.alreadyRunning: The task already has an active run
errors.circuitOpen: {failures, plural, one {The last run} other {The last # runs}} of this task failed ({reason}), so it does not start again on its own. Start it yourself once the cause is fixed.

comments.capReached: Pull request {label} still needs fixes after {rounds} automatic fix rounds, so the agent is not woken again. Look at it, then start the task again when it should continue.
comments.closed: Pull request {label} was closed without merging: {url}

notices.capReached: Task "{title}" is blocked: pull request {label} still needs fixes after {rounds} automatic fix rounds. {url}
notices.notWoken: Pull request {label} of task "{title}" needs fixes, but its agent was not started: {reason}. {url}
notices.closed: Pull request {label} of task "{title}" was closed without merging. {url}

slots.waitingTitle: Waiting for a free place: it starts on its own when one of the other delegated tasks finishes
slots.waitingHint: Only a few tasks delegated from the same conversation run at once (Settings > Agents). This one starts on its own when one of them finishes; Run now starts it right away.
slots.startFailed: This task waited for a free place and could not start when one freed up: {reason}. Fix the cause, then start it again.

condition.timerEvery: Every {minutes, plural, one {minute} other {# minutes}}, next: {time}
condition.prChecksFinished: The CI checks of pull request {label} to finish

stopped.loop: it kept waking the agent with no person in between (a loop)
stopped.rate: the task was woken {max} times in the last hour

comments.stopped:
These waits stopped and no longer wake the agent:
{items}
comments.blocked: The task is blocked until you look at it: remove the waits or start the task again.

notices.stopped:
Task "{title}": a wait of its agent stopped.
{items}
notices.notWoken: Task "{title}": what its agent waited for happened, but the agent was not started: {reason}.

automation.fromSchedule: Started by a schedule. The result goes to {agent}.
automation.fromTrigger: Started by a trigger. The result goes to {agent}.
automation.payloadReference: (the data the trigger received, in the comment below)
automation.nothingNew: Nothing new: the result needs nobody's attention, so nobody was told. It stays here, in the output.
automation.reviewDescription: Check what {agent} delivered for this schedule or trigger (the subtask), then report the outcome.

control.cancelled: {count, plural, one {Task cancelled} other {# tasks cancelled}}
control.pausedFor: Put aside for an <link>urgent task</link>; it resumes by itself once that one is settled.
control.pausedHint: Its run stopped at its last step. Resume it when it should go on.
control.cancelDescription: Its runs stop and nobody works on it again. Whoever gave it is told.
control.reasonPlaceholder: Why, for whoever gave the task
control.cascade: Also cancel its subtasks and the work delegated from it
control.redirectDescription: Change its course while it is underway. Only what you change is applied.
control.instructionsHint: They reach the agent at once, even mid-run.

messages.label: Message to the agent
messages.placeholder: Tell the agent what to change; it reads it at once, even mid-run (Ctrl+Enter to send)

delivered.steered: Delivered into the running run: the agent reads it at its next step
delivered.follow-up: Delivered: the agent reads it right after its current step
delivered.woke: The agent was woken to act on it
delivered.slot: Stored: the agent starts on it as soon as a place frees up
delivered.stored: Stored: the agent reads it at its next run
delivered.withheld: Stored, not delivered: the project's AI providers keep it from this agent
